description: This file defines classes and structures related to MPEG tables, specifically Program Association Table (PAT) and Program Map Table (PMT), used in MPEG broadcasting. It includes class definitions, iterators, and methods for handling MPEG section data.

classes.name: PAT
classes.description: Represents the MPEG Program Association Table, providing access to program information and transport stream ID.

classes.name: ProgramIterator
classes.description: Iterator for traversing programs within the PAT.

classes.name: PMT
classes.description: Represents the MPEG Program Map Table, providing access to program streams and descriptors.

classes.name: StreamIterator
classes.description: Iterator for traversing streams within a PMT.

methods.name: TransportStreamId
methods.description: Returns the transport stream ID associated with the PAT.

methods.name: Programs
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the programs listed in the PAT.

methods.name: ProgramNumber
methods.description: Returns the program number for a specific program in the PAT.

methods.name: Pid
methods.description: Returns the PID associated with a program in the PAT.

methods.name: Streams
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the streams in a PMT.

methods.name: Descriptors
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the descriptors associated with a stream in a PMT.

methods.name: PCRPid
methods.description: Returns the PCR PID for a program in the PMT.
